description: Learning-curve tier N = 400 (every tier strictly truncates the dictionary and the Opus name lists at N, and the setting is fixed). Weak labels for setting S3 only, the setting fixed by the configs/train_v2.json rule (highest mean dev micro F1 over seeds 1-3) before any tier was trained; built by novel_ner.weak with everything else as configs/weak_v2.json (see its description for the sources, S3 and the conversions K1-K4). Training chapters: 1-400 minus the development chapters (dev_config). Truncation (the build record's truncation.rules says it in words; strict except the residual stated below under "Not strict"): (1) Opus lists: a training label uses only the lists of training chapters up to 400: the chapter's own list for positives; the other-chapter lexicon, the known person names of K1/K2 and the same_as tail abbreviations of K4 come from training chapters only, never from a development chapter or a chapter after 400; (2) dictionary_cutoff = 400: a dictionary row is kept only if its reveal chapter (known) is 400 or earlier, its scope (if any) starts by 400, its name occurs in a training chapter's text up to 400, and, for a row without a reveal chapter (items, dungeons from the unit index, registry rows without known), the first chapter up to 780 whose Opus list has its name or canonical name (as name or same_as) is 400 or earlier (the listing date: the item library and the registry were built from the Opus lists, so a row's first listing stands for when it entered them, and unit names are dated the same way; the date reads the lists of every chapter up to 780, development chapters and chapters after 400 included, never a chapter after 780, and only ever drops a row the other rules keep, never adds a row or a string to a label; a development chapter's list can date a row by 400 where the training chapters' lists alone would not, and the record counts such rows; a late listing also drops a row the book may already use by 400 under that name, so the rule errs toward dropping); (3) a dictionary row counts as a K4 tail abbreviation only if its canonical name also occurs in a training chapter's text up to 400. Label versions: the snapshot's Opus lists are prompt extract_v1 for chapters 1-453 and extract_v1.1 for chapters 454-780, so tiers N <= 453 (50, 100, 200, 400) hold only extract_v1 lists. This tier holds only extract_v1 lists (chapters 1-400; chapters 18-22 were listed by claude-fable-5-1, the rest by claude-opus-5-5). The record counts the training mention rows by prompt version and model and the positive spans by the version of the chapter list behind them. Not truncated (stated, cannot be removed here): the Opus lists themselves were made by the novel project with a prompt holding the earlier chapters' entities, the chapter's plot-unit name and the book's dungeon-name list from its unit index, so a list can carry some later knowledge of dungeon and unit names; a kept dictionary row's type and canonical name are the registry's final view; the conversion word lists (title_suffixes, category_words, grade_category_pattern) are fixed config written once for the 1-780 labels and are the same in every tier. Not strict (stated residual; labels keep it): a row without a reveal chapter that no Opus list up to 780 names has no date and is kept by the text test in (2) alone, a substring test, so such a name the book introduces only after 400 is kept if the same characters occur by 400 as an ordinary word, an idiom or part of a longer word (the way 钥匙 occurs inside 钥匙扣 long before the item 钥匙); such a row never adds a positive (positives need the chapter's own list) but can make training occurrences uncertain (no loss). The build record counts the rows the listing date drops (named, with their first listing, in the label directory), lists every kept row without a reveal chapter with the first training chapter up to 400 whose text has its name, its first listing up to 780 and its first listing in a training chapter, and counts the training spans and regions such rows back: all of them, the undated residual, and the rows dated only by a list not trained on. Development labels (all 31 dev chapters, never trained on) use each dev chapter's own list, also for dev chapters after 400, with the truncated dictionary and the training-only lexicon; they are scored as a system on the 31 answered dev chapters (dev answers v2).
